plays_on: browsers — the engine is a few MB to load, slower to start on a phone
iPhones (App Store) — the build needs a Mac with Xcode
choose.suits: 2D or 3D with scenes, physics, tilemaps, animation and UI built in; free; needs the Godot editor (GDScript — a C# game cannot go to a browser)
choose.pick_when: the game may go to a store or a computer at all, even later, or it is 3D or large (many levels, physics at its heart) — and it is not a phone game first

editor.name: Godot
missing: Install Godot 4 (https://godotengine.org/download) — the kit's commands call `godot`, so put it on PATH under that name.
If it is somewhere else, put the executable's path in the environment variable GODOT and run this again.
